hotspots.name: The Assignment Board
hotspots.description: Tingen’s open files, pinned in Dunn’s handwriting and re-pinned in Rozanne’s when his becomes unreadable. Sealed Artifact recoveries, a missing persons that is not a missing persons, and one card with your own address on it.

hotspots.name: The Requisition Cabinet
hotspots.description: What the Church will sign out to a Nighthawk, at cost, against a docket. Charms, chalk, and the potions themselves — which are not sold so much as issued, with a form and a countersignature.

hotspots.name: The Ritual Room
hotspots.description: A cellar room with a drain in the floor and the marks of a hundred circles scrubbed off the flagstones. Where a Nighthawk takes a potion, because a Nighthawk who takes one alone in a rented room is how the team learns he had one.

hotspots.name: Dunn’s Desk
hotspots.description: Where a case is reported and closed. He listens without writing anything down, and remembers all of it, which is the only thing about him that is never absent-minded.

hotspots.name: The Back Room Cot
hotspots.description: For nights a Nighthawk should not be going home. Nothing has ever come through that door, and everyone here can tell you the number of the artifact that makes that true.

hotspots.name: Old Neil’s Lectern
hotspots.description: Theory, ritual grammar, and the parts of the Church’s index a probationary member is cleared to read. He will teach anyone who sits down, at length, for a fee that goes into the tea fund.

hotspots.name: The Correspondence Desk
hotspots.description: Where the legwork is bought: a note to a records clerk, a coin to a ferryman, an afternoon of somebody else’s time. Slower than a power, and it does not cost you anything you cannot get back.

hotspots.name: Longcase Clock
hotspots.description: Stopped at 11:47, and nobody winds it. Dunn says it stopped on its own the night the last captain died and that he would rather it stayed stopped, and nobody in Tingen argues with Dunn about clocks.

hotspots.name: The Cellar Room
hotspots.description: A drain in the floor and a chair bolted beside it. This is where the Church’s phials are drunk.

locked.reason: Nothing has been signed for you yet.

hotspots.name: The Back Room
hotspots.description: A cleared floor, a cheval glass with a crack across the corner, and Old Neil in the one chair, waiting to be performed at.
